tools.name: search_corpus
tools.description: Semantic search over 11M+ biomedical paper abstracts (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv). Finds papers by MEANING, not keywords. Returns papers ranked by a hybrid relevance score (semantic similarity + lexical overlap + citation quality + recency) with abstracts, PMIDs, metadata and DOI links. Supports filte

tools.name: search_corpus_keyword
tools.description: KEYWORD/Boolean search over the same 11M+ biomedical abstracts, matching EXACT TERMS rather than meaning.
